notes.title: Patch day 25/08/2024
notes.content:
Location correction: spanish.
 Minor bugs fix.
 Now the player can't use the shovel while dead.

notes.title: Day 2 patch (17/08/2024)
notes.content:
Language fixes: Catalan.
 Added barriers on the sides of the river at the dock.
 Blue enemies are now affected by the final spell.
 Various changes to sprite layers.
 Fixed the bug that awarded the hearts achievement at the start of a new game.
 The digger's dialogue now takes one second longer to disappear.
 Added a fade-out effect after dying inside the castle.
